name: uart-baseline
description: Structural baseline for the shipped UART example: the feedback loops of the design (strongly connected components of the netlist graph) and the connectivity of the whole graph. Both steps are deterministic, so a second run of this configuration reuses their checkpoints instead of recomputing them.

steps.description: Strongly connected components of at least two gates: the sequential feedback paths of the design. For examples/uart.zip these are the receiver clock counter, the transmitter counter and the bit counter (68, 50 and 15 gates).
Weakly connected components of the same graph: how many independent blocks the netlist falls apart into. The UART is one block of 407 gates.
